snippet.title: Dispatch - Official PC and PS5 Release Date Trailer (ft. Aaron Paul, Jeffrey Wright)
snippet.description: Dispatch, the upcoming workplace superhero comedy adventure game with a strategy layer from a group of ex-Telltale developers, is coming to PC and PS5 on October 22. Dispatch stars Aaron Paul and Jeffrey Wright and is developed by AdHoc, a new studio comprised of a number of former Telltale developers. It will be released episodically over the course of four weeks, with two episodes dropping each week starting on October 22. It's priced at $30 for the full season, or $40 for deluxe version of the full season that includes a digital artbook and four digital comics. Wishlist it and/or check out the playable demo right now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2592160/Dispatch/
